description: ONS: Taxas TEIFa e TEIP, published by Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS), reports equivalent forced and scheduled unavailability rates for centrally dispatched plants over the latest 60 months. Coverage: The product covers Brazil's interconnected electricity system, with the aggregation and equipment thresholds in its definition. Temporal resolution: Not specified in the reviewed metadata. Coverage: Latest 60 months, rolling. The linked ONS CKAN API identifies the product and its downloadable formats. Observation files and attached data dictionaries were not downloaded. The provider labels the product Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), without a version in the reviewed metadata. Public metadata access required no registration; attribution and change disclosure remain applicable. Limitations: ONS warns that consistency checks can revise published values. Completeness, schemas and observation contents were not independently checked. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
